groups.heading:
Small upgrades.
A better everyday.
groups.description: Practical help with the technology, connections and finishing touches that make a home work.

items.title: TV mounting
items.description: Secure TV installation, including Samsung Frame TVs, soundbar mounting and cable management for a clean finish.

items.title: Smart home setup
items.description: Video doorbells, smart locks, thermostats, lighting and connected devices, set up to work with your daily routine.

items.title: Wi-Fi & networking
items.description: Mesh Wi-Fi, access points, Ethernet cabling and wireless bridges to connect more of your home and property.

items.title: Security cameras
items.description: PoE cameras, NVR systems and camera positioning, with help configuring recording and remote viewing.

items.title: Home audio
items.description: Sonos systems, in-ceiling and outdoor speakers, soundbars and audio wiring for the spaces you enjoy.

items.title: Handyman services
items.description: Furniture assembly, mounting, home repairs, minor electrical and plumbing. Practical help for your to-do list.

groups.heading:
Your to-do list.
Taken care of.
groups.description: From assembling furniture to replacing a fixture, get help with the everyday jobs that keep your home comfortable and working well.

items.title: Furniture assembly & mounting
items.description: Assembly of IKEA and other flat-pack furniture, plus secure mounting of shelves, mirrors, artwork and other wall decor.

items.title: Blinds, curtains & screens
items.description: Installation of window blinds, curtain rods and other window treatments, plus window-screen repairs.

items.title: Door hardware & smart locks
items.description: Installation of door handles, locksets, deadbolts and smart door locks, with setup for connected models.

items.title: Drywall repair & painting
items.description: Drywall patching, light wall repairs, interior touch-up painting and painting to refresh your space.

items.title: Minor electrical work
items.description: Outlet and receptacle replacement, additional outlets, light-fixture and ceiling-fan replacement, and doorbell transformer installation.

items.title: Minor plumbing & drains
items.description: Drain snaking and clog clearing, plus kitchen, bathroom and shower fixture replacements, including faucets, showerheads, sinks and toilets.
